title: 第25章 五大亲传出手第26章 土拨鼠尖叫
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
眨眼间，两拳碰撞在一起。
古力的拳头很大，而曹立的拳头很小。
幻想中摧枯拉朽的情况并没有出现，一股强大的劲风，从两个拳头的交手处冲开，劲风吹得围观的人衣服猎猎作响。
古力的笑容僵住了，紧接着，痛感和麻痹感同时产生。
他倒飞了出去，落地之后，还倒退了两步。
手臂很麻很麻，还有点微微的发颤。
反观曹立，站在原地，纹丝未动。
古力实力还是很强的，跟曹立对上一拳，居然没被打成残废。
古力内心无比震撼，他可是结丹中期的体修，曹立怎么可能~~~
他现在很怀疑，曹立在撒谎，他其实不是二十多岁，而是两百多岁的天骄。
“你是法体同修？”古力的语气有一丝凝重。
后面的亲传弟子，脸色都变了。
这人是变态吧，硬拼毫无保留的古力而毫发无损？
“你猜？”曹立一副淡然的态度。
小虎等弱鸡练气境，直接被两拳相交的劲风吹得后退，其中一个小弟站不稳，摔倒在地，还翻了个滚。
小虎傻眼了，曹哥这么厉害的吗？连亲传弟子古力都不惧？
那可是年轻一辈排名前三的结丹境啊！
曹哥是结丹，我草，大腿！
而围观的内门弟子，更是傻眼了，他们没有看错吧，曹立肉身实力不弱于结丹境体修？
曹长老的实力，这是比亲传还牛啊！

后面几个亲传弟子，看得一清二楚，曹立真的太夸张了。
葛颜吞了口口水，原本以为叫了人，可以探探曹立的底，看样子，古力都不是他的对手。
法体同修，法力抵达结丹境，体修强度也不弱于结丹境，这才二十多岁，这是什么牌子的妖孽！
葛颜有点傻眼。
而握着玉笛，一直挂着笑容的玉笛男子他饶有兴趣的看着曹立，有点东西。
但他还是挂着笑容，似乎压力并不大。
其他两个女生的亲传弟子，神情突然严肃了起来。
事态有点超出预期了。
古力顿时心中有了战意。
肉体也很强是吧，那就来试试。
他古力可是沐浴过上古凶兽遗留下来的血液，体魄才能如此强壮，不知道你，是吃过什么天材地宝。
他双手抓紧了凶兽遗骨，这下子，他要动真格了。
古力在原地留下一个残影，瞬间又来到了曹立面前，凶兽遗骨猛的砸下。
曹立在原地留下一道残影，人已经避开了古力的一砸。
砰的一声，被凶兽遗骨锤到的地方，仿佛被扔了一块炸弹，站着的人，都能感受到地面的强烈震动。
而那个地方，直接出现了一个大坑。
古力抬眼，看到曹立在空中。
“哪里跑！”他迅速追了上去。
而曹立自然不会再躲，凌阳剑直接出现在自己手上，带着耀眼的金光居高临下一挥。
古力抓着凶兽遗骨，和曹立的凌阳剑硬碰硬来了一记。

古力直接被砸飞了，摔落在地。
掀起很多尘埃，凶兽遗骨上，出现了一道一厘米深的剑痕。
古力狼狈的爬了起来，眼睛看着凶兽遗骨上面的剑痕，这怎么可能……
上古凶兽的遗骨，居然被留下了痕迹。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, the two fists collided.
Gu Li's fist is very big, while Cao Li's fist is very small.
The devastating situation in the fantasy did not appear. A strong wind rushed away from the intersection of the two fists. The strong wind blew the clothes of the onlookers rustling.
Gu Li's smile froze, and then he felt pain and numbness at the same time.
He flew out upside down and took two steps back after landing.
My arms were very numb and slightly trembling.
On the other hand, Cao Li stood where he was, not moving at all.
Gu Li is still very strong. He punched Cao Li and was not maimed.
Gu Li was extremely shocked. He was a physical practitioner in the middle stage of pill formation. How could Cao Li do this~~~
He is now very suspicious that Cao Li is lying. In fact, he is not in his twenties, but a genius who is over 200 years old.
"Are you a Dharma practitioner?" Gu Li's tone was solemn.
The expressions of the direct disciples behind him changed.
Is this person a pervert? He fought hard with no reservations and got away unscathed?
"What do you think?" Cao Li said with an indifferent attitude.
Xiaohu and other weak chickens were practicing in the Qi state, but were directly blown back by the strong wind between the two fists. One of the boys lost his balance, fell to the ground, and rolled over.
Xiaohu was dumbfounded. Is Brother Cao so powerful? Not even afraid of his direct disciple Gu Li?
Those are the top three Dan Formation realms among the younger generation!
Brother Cao is a pill-former, my grass is my thigh!
The inner disciples who were watching were even more dumbfounded. Were they right? Cao Li's physical strength was not weaker than that of the Dan Jie realm.
Elder Cao's strength is even better than his own!
The few direct disciples behind him could see clearly that Cao Li was really exaggerating.
Ge Yan swallowed his saliva, originally thinking that he could find out Cao Li's background by calling someone, but it seemed that even Gu Li was no match for him.
A fellow cultivator of the Dharma Body, his magic power has reached the realm of pill formation, and his physical strength is not weaker than that of the realm of pill formation. He is only in his twenties, what kind of monster is he!
Ge Yan was a little dumbfounded.
The man with the jade flute who was holding the jade flute and smiling all the time looked at Cao Li with interest, and there was something interesting.
But he still smiled and seemed not to be under much pressure.
The expressions of the other two girls' direct disciples suddenly became serious.
Things went a bit beyond expectations.
Gu Li suddenly felt a fighting spirit in his heart.
The body is also very strong, right? Let’s try it.
He, Guli, has been bathed in the blood left by ancient ferocious beasts, and his body can be so strong. I don't know what kind of treasures he has eaten.
He grasped the remains of the ferocious beast with both hands, and now he was going to take action for real.
Gu Li left an afterimage on the spot, and instantly came to Cao Li again, and the beast's bones slammed down.
Cao Li left an afterimage on the spot, and he had already avoided Gu Li's blow.
With a bang, the place where the beast's bones were hammered felt as if a bomb had been thrown, and anyone standing could feel the strong vibrations on the ground.
And a big pit appeared directly in that place.
Gu Li raised his eyes and saw Cao Li in the air.
"Where to run!" He quickly chased after him.
Naturally, Cao Li would no longer hide. The Lingyang Sword appeared directly in his hand, wielding it condescendingly with a dazzling golden light.
Gu Li grabbed the remains of the ferocious beast and clashed head-on with Cao Li's Lingyang Sword.
Gu Li was directly knocked away and fell to the ground.
A lot of dust was stirred up, and a sword mark one centimeter deep appeared on the beast's bones.
Gu Li climbed up in embarrassment and looked at the sword marks on the beast's bones. How could this be possible...
The remains of ancient ferocious beasts actually left traces.
